name: xce_architecture_context
description: Get architectural context for a file or symbol from the indexed knowledge graph.

arguments.name: file_or_symbol
arguments.desc: File path or symbol name to get architectural context for.

arguments.name: repo_id
arguments.desc: Repository identifier the repo was indexed under.

name: xce_search
description: Search the knowledge graph by semantic meaning, symbol, or tag.

arguments.name: repo_id
arguments.desc: Repository identifier the repo was indexed under.

arguments.name: search_type
arguments.desc: Type of search: semantic, symbol, or tag.

name: xce_impact_analysis
description: Predict the blast radius (callers, dependents, affected modules) for proposed code changes.

arguments.name: changed_files
arguments.desc: List of changed file paths to analyze.

arguments.name: repo_id
arguments.desc: Repository identifier the repo was indexed under.

name: xce_trace
description: Trace relationships between code and design artifacts across abstraction levels (code, component, architecture).

arguments.name: source
arguments.desc: Source code symbol or file to trace from.

arguments.name: target_level
arguments.desc: Target abstraction level: code, component, or architecture.

arguments.name: repo_id
arguments.desc: Repository identifier the repo was indexed under.

name: xce_index_repo
description: Index or re-index a code repository into the knowledge graph.

arguments.name: repo_path
arguments.desc: Path to the repository to index.

arguments.name: repo_id
arguments.desc: Repository identifier to index the repo under.
